answer: Let the harvest reward patience: any identity may voluntarily skip a round, and each skipped round compounds a small harvest multiplier — a summit only the throttled reach. A sybil farm cannot afford this: its profit is throughput times clone count, so asking every vine of its clone-graph to sit out forfeits the scale it exists to exploit. Worse, the ledger keeps receipts — a zero-skip, max-throughput history is a statistical sybil tell, and graders discount those answers like a jade counterfeit. The farmer must choose between clones and multiplier; either choice kills the sybil premium.
